details.detail: Aisle vault: the arch, the 2-frame panel pitch and the continuous soft joint arcs are right. The vault now has a visible gradient from the grille toward the centre bin (v6 row 150: 246 falling to 236). Two differences remain. (1) The falloff is still too shallow. In b_sany_y22 the vault runs from about 0.8 of the band at the grille to about 0.6 at the crease. In the model it runs from 0.99 to 0.96 of the band, then steps to 190 at the centre-bin door. (2) The joints are still plain transverse arcs. In y22 and c119 they are raised ribs that sweep aft along the centre-bin crest (cosmetic).

Slotted grille: FIXED. It is now a slim 0.05 m mid-grey slot strip with 2 segments per panel and bridges on the panel joints (v6, p1, h_trough). It no longer reads as a zebra stripe, and its width relative to the band matches y22_cove.

Cove light: width FIXED. On v6 row 150 the diffuser is about 70 px against a grille of about 20 px (3.5x), which matches c119 (115 against 40) and y22. One residual: the glow still appears on both sides of the grille. The vault right inboard of the grille renders at 246 against the band's 247, so the grille still sits inside a white field rather than at the edge of the light. Cause: in 07b the vault eFn peaks at 0.08 + 0.22 = 0.30 at the grille, which equals CEILMAT.cove e 0.30. The '0.55 of the band' cap was measured against the 0.85 plateau outboard (ax > 1.66), not against the diffuser.
Outboard bins: still right. They have 2-frame modules, one latch at about 45 %, and the rail placard '35 ▭▭▭' facing the aisle (p1). Seams are light hairlines.

Centre bins: IMPROVED. The channel now reads recessed, at 163 against the door's 192 (0.85; y_47300 is 0.76, r3 was 0.98). From the side (p2) the door shows form, light at the top and grey at the lower wrap. From below (v1, v6), though, both surfaces are still single constant values over hundreds of pixels: door 192 at every y from 0 to 220, channel 163 at every y from 0 to 220. The bulge's curvature therefore shows only at its edges. The doors are also now clearly greyer than the outboard doors and the vault. That is plausible against b_sany_y22 but not against y_47300, where the centre doors are as white as the vault.
Latches: stadium plate, dark well and lever, correctly placed (p1, p2).

Outboard PSU: REGRESSED in contrast. The wells are now darker, 154 on a band of 209 (0.74; r3 was 190 on 214, 0.89). Each well is ringed by a 1-2 px dark outline at 105 (v4 x 96, y 200). This is because the band has e 0.16 while BINMAT.well has e 0.05 and wellRim has no emissive at all. The wells look even more like grey stickers than before. In thrifty_j_overhead-vent the well is the same plastic as the band and reads only through soft lip shading. The proud filler modules are still missing.

Centre PSU channel: the 4-gasper stadium, the sign pill and the eyeball rows sit where they do in b_sany_y22, and the joints are irregular. Minor: the photo shows joints in pairs; the model's are single.
Signs: smoked pills with amber and red icons at the correct aspect, with no z-fighting (v8, p1).
Row placards: readable on both the outboard rail and the centre door top (p1, p2). The centre door still lacks the raised rail seen in c119 (cosmetic).
Ceiling EXIT signs: a light box reading '← 非常口 EXIT →' at the zone ends (v3, v7), matching b_sany_y22.
Speaker and emergency fittings: the rounded rectangle with a perforated field and the framed lens both still match c119 (h_trough, v2).

Door-area ceilings: the sliver is FIXED. v3 (360-380, 300-310) is now a neutral (230,230,230), and only 65 px anywhere in v3 carry even a faint cool tint, all of them on distant cabin surfaces. The dome, downlight, light strips and EXIT box are fine (v3, v7). The zone-end closure over the centre-bin crest reads as a thin light shelf (v3 top-left, 0-360 x 270-300), which is acceptable. The door-3 canopy belongs to monuments.

issues.detail: The vault inboard of the grille glows as brightly as the cove diffuser and barely falls off toward the centre bin.
issues.problem: Lighting proportion. The grille should mark the edge of the light, with the vault beyond it clearly dimmer and fading, as in b_sany_y22 and c119.
issues.evidence: v6 row 150: band 247, grille, vault 246 falling to 236, then the door at 190. y22: band 255, vault about 200-233 at the grille, falling to about 150. 07b eFn: 0.08 + 0.22 * exp(...) = 0.30 at xg, the same as CEILMAT.cove e 0.30. Both sit in the ACES shoulder.
issues.fix: 07b_ceiling.js vault eFn: inboard of xg return 0.06 + 0.10 * exp(-(xg - ax) / 0.35), which peaks near 0.5 of the cove. Keep 0.85 outboard (ax > 1.66). Emissive alone cannot pull a lit white down much, so also bake an albedo gradient on the vault. After building the sweep, scale the vertex colours by lerp(1.0, 0.84, clamp((xg - |x|) / (xg - 0.73), 0, 1)), in the same way as shadeUpper. Optionally raise CEILMAT.cove e to 0.40 so the band keeps the top value.

Or give doorC a small eFn that rises toward the crest (0.14 at the crest, 0.06 at the lower wrap) so the door grades from light at the top to grey at the bottom, as in y_47300 (245 to 200).
